title: Files from vaults leak names in apps' non-encrypted "recent items" lists
line: Locking a vault now removes its files from recent-file lists, the launcher's History and task manager jump lists.
explanation: Apps record opened files in recently-used.xbel and in kactivitymanagerd's stats like any other file, and nothing removed vault paths when the vault was locked, so Kickoff History, Recent Files and jump lists kept showing their names and paths. Deleting the stats was also not reliable: if a score update for the file was still queued (for example when the editor had just closed), kactivitymanagerd recreated the entry a second later. KIO gains KRecentDocument::removeFilesInDirectory(), which plasma-vault's kded calls with the mount point whenever a vault reaches the Closed state (also on kded start, for vaults left over from a previous session), together with a request to kactivitymanagerd to delete the stats for '<mountpoint>/*'; kactivitymanagerd now drops queued score updates for resources whose stats were deleted.

commits.message:
krecentdocument: Add removeFilesInDirectory()

Callers that need to drop every recent entry under a folder, such as an
encrypted vault being locked, had to parse recently-used.xbel by hand,
since recentUrls() skips files that no longer exist. Add a call for it.

CCBUG: 444393

kded: Forget recent files from a vault when it is locked

Files opened from a vault stayed in recently-used.xbel and in the
activity stats after locking, so their names and paths kept showing in
launchers and jump lists. Remove those entries whenever a vault closes.

BUG: 444393

sqlite: Don't bring back scores of resources that were just forgotten

When stats were deleted while a score update for the same resource was
still queued, the update ran right after and recreated the cache entry,
so the forgotten file came back in recent lists. Drop such queued updates.

BUG: 444393

media.caption: Vault 'Priv' locked: Kickoff > Places > History still lists secret-notes.txt in Home/Vaults/Priv
Same steps with the fix: after locking, both vault files (incl. one in a subfolder) are gone from History; public-notes.txt stays

review.text: Purges vault paths from recently-used.xbel (new KRecentDocument::removeFilesInDirectory in KIO, the right place) and from kactivitymanagerd stats on lock, and fixes the KAMD race where queued score updates recreated deleted stats. Version-guarded in plasma-vault, verified on several lock cycles and with neighbouring paths untouched. It purges on lock rather than preventing recording, which is a reasonable scope for this bug.
